item.title: Show HN: Developer Inbox
item.summary: I am working on a Developer Inbox open source platform to create Email Client using existing API based email infra like resent, sendgrid etc to manage early startups's custom email conversation. Starting with resend and will add support for other platform soon. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49204040 Points: 3 # Comments: 1
